conclusion: H0.25 failed its preregistered broad synthetic robustness retain rule in both independent seeds because maximum regret was slightly worse than R0_T2 despite better mean regret. The negative result was honored. Repeated weakness localized to local rank reversal and non-monotone score-strength worlds, showing that global temperature mixing is insufficient for structural misspecification. A consumed-world S1 ambiguity-shrinkage development grid reduced worst-case regret but materially harmed mean regret and was not advanced to fresh validation. Research pivots to selective pair-local/rank-robust structural uncertainty models. R0_T2 prospective assignment remains unchanged and independent.
